title: Public Alert No. 025/2025 – Alert on the Unauthorized Auction and Circulation of Expired Insecticide (LARA FORCE LAMBDA 1L)
summary: NAFDAC warns that 5,000 cartons of expired Lara Force Lambda-Cyhalothrin 2.5% 1L insecticide (batch XZH2020006, expired 7 March 2023) were unlawfully auctioned and are circulating. Expired product risks poor pest control, higher toxicity and environmental harm.
